# Apps by Gerrit Schimpf

> Focused Android apps by Gerrit Schimpf that each do one job well. Every app and guide below has a Markdown page with all it says on the web.

Website: https://apps.schimpf.es/
Sitemap: https://apps.schimpf.es/sitemap.xml

## Apps

- [Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/index.md): Reliable alarms for heavy sleepers. Solve a task to switch the alarm off.
- [Allotment Club Ledger](https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/index.md): Rent, dues, meters and receipts for allotment club treasurers
- [Anti-Bucket List: No Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/index.md): Write down what you said no to and check later if you're still glad.
- [Binaural Beats](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/index.md): Binaural and isochronic beats to relax, focus or sleep.
- [Der Monarch](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/index.md): Turn-based economic strategy in 1720s Germany: rise from reeve to emperor.
- [Dyslexia Reader: Book Reader](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/index.md): Read books with dyslexia-friendly fonts, a line ruler and read aloud.
- [GLP Mate: GLP-1 Shot Tracker](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/index.md): Private diary for GLP-1 shots, side effects, weight, food and supply.
- [Grief Letter Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/index.md): Write unsent letters to someone you lost. Private and encrypted on your phone.
- [Health Reports: BP & Sleep PDF](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/index.md): Turn Health Connect blood pressure, heart rate and sleep into a PDF report.
- [Hipoteca: Mortgage Calculator](https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/index.md): Plan, compare and track a Spanish mortgage: costs, taxes and Euríbor risk.
- [Hive Log: Beekeeping Journal](https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/index.md): Log hive inspections, treatments and feedings, track varroa, set reminders.
- [Horse Care Log: Farrier & Vet](https://apps.schimpf.es/horse-care-log/index.md): Horse care log: farrier, vaccines, worming, vet notes, costs, reminders.
- [Job Loss Plan: 12-Week Guide](https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/index.md): Laid off? A calm 12-week checklist with deadlines, budget and runway math.
- [Metronome & Practice Log](https://apps.schimpf.es/metronome-and-practice-log/index.md): Metronome that logs your practice time automatically and tracks your streak
- [Minijob Calculator Germany](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-german-minijob-calculator/index.md): German Minijob limit, hours and employer cost 2026/2027. No account.
- [Numeric IBS Symptom Scorer](https://apps.schimpf.es/numeric-ibs-symptom-scorer/index.md): Rate IBS symptoms 0-10, log bowel movements and food, spot possible triggers.
- [Paint Calc: Room Paint Amount](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/index.md): Work out how much paint a room needs, with coats, doors and waste
- [PDF Reader & Scanner](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-pdf-reader-and-scanner/index.md): Read, search, scan and sign PDFs on your phone.
- [Plumber Invoice & Quote Maker](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/index.md): Plumbing quotes, signatures, invoices and payments for plumbers
- [Storage Analyzer: Big Files](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/index.md): Find large files, duplicates and old junk, then clear space safely.
- [Stutter Practice: DAF](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/index.md): DAF, paced speech and easy onset practice for people who stutter.
- [TDS Section Calc India](https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/index.md): Calculate TDS by section with 1961 and 2025 Act numbers and due dates.

## Guides

- [Alarm Not Going Off on Android: Causes and Fixes](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/alarm-not-going-off-android/index.md): Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions, Why an Android alarm stays silent or rings late, and a checklist of settings to fix it, from exact alarms to battery limits.
- [Math Alarm Problems: Easy, Medium and Hard Examples](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/math-alarm-problems-examples/index.md): Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions, See what easy, medium and hard math alarm problems look like, how they are built, and how to pick a level that wakes you up.
- [Snooze Time Calculator: How Late Will You Wake Up?](https://apps.schimpf.es/alarm-clock/snooze-time-calculator/index.md): Alarm Clock: Wake-Up Missions, Work out how many minutes snoozing costs you and when the last alarm rings. Includes a calculator and a worked example.
- [Allotment water meter cost: formula and example](https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/allotment-water-meter-cost-calculation/index.md): Allotment Club Ledger, How to bill water or electricity in an allotment club from meter readings: formula, base fee, worked example and what to do with odd readings.
- [Gemeinschaftsstunden Ersatzgeld berechnen](https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/gemeinschaftsstunden-ersatzgeld-berechnen/index.md): Allotment Club Ledger, How to calculate the fee for missed community work hours in a German allotment club, with proration for members who join mid-year and an example.
- [Kleingarten Pacht berechnen: per m² and by month](https://apps.schimpf.es/german-allotment-club-ledger/kleingarten-pacht-berechnen/index.md): Allotment Club Ledger, How to calculate allotment garden rent (Pachtzins) per m², and how to split it by month when a tenant changes mid-year. With a worked example.
- [How to Keep a Journal of Things You Said No To](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/how-to-keep-a-decision-journal-of-no/index.md): Anti-Bucket List: No Journal, A step-by-step way to record what you declined, why it felt that way, and when to review it. Includes a 30 and 90 day check-in schedule.
- [Regret Rate Calculator: How Often Do You Regret No?](https://apps.schimpf.es/anti-bucket-list/regret-rate-calculator/index.md): Anti-Bucket List: No Journal, Work out your regret rate for the things you declined. Formula, a worked example and a small calculator you can use right here.
- [Binaural Beat Frequency Calculator and Formula](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/binaural-beat-frequency-calculator/index.md): Binaural Beats, Work out the left and right tone for any binaural beat with one formula, a worked example and a small calculator. Includes how a beat glides over time.
- [Brainwave Frequency Chart: Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma](https://apps.schimpf.es/binaural-beats/brainwave-frequency-chart/index.md): Binaural Beats, A chart of the five brainwave bands in Hz, what each is usually linked to, and which beat rates to use when you listen to binaural beats.
- [Der Monarch feeding and harvest guide with formulas](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/der-monarch-feeding-and-harvest-guide/index.md): Der Monarch, How much grain your people need in Der Monarch, how crops and soil set the harvest, and how feeding changes population. With worked examples.
- [Der Monarch ranks and what each rank needs](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/der-monarch-rank-requirements/index.md): Der Monarch, Table of every rank in Der Monarch, from Landvogt to Kaiser, with the people, land, palace, cathedral and markets each one needs.
- [Der Monarch sea routes chart: cost, return and odds](https://apps.schimpf.es/der-monarch/der-monarch-sea-routes-chart/index.md): Der Monarch, All 10 sea routes in Der Monarch with cost, years, chance of return and loot, plus the expected gain of each voyage.
- [Dyslexia-Friendly Fonts Compared and How to Set Them Up](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/dyslexia-friendly-fonts-compared/index.md): Dyslexia Reader: Book Reader, Lexend, OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible compared, with research notes and starting values for font size and letter, word and line spacing.
- [How to Read a PDF in a Dyslexia-Friendly Font on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/read-pdf-with-dyslexia-font/index.md): Dyslexia Reader: Book Reader, PDFs lock the font and layout. Here is how to turn a text PDF into reflowable text on Android and what limits apply.
- [Reading Time Calculator: How Long to Read a Book](https://apps.schimpf.es/dyslexia-reader-android/reading-time-calculator/index.md): Dyslexia Reader: Book Reader, Work out how long a book takes to read from its word or character count. Formula, worked examples and a small calculator.
- [BMI Calculator and Chart: Formula in kg/cm and lb/in](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/bmi-calculator-kg-cm-lb-in/index.md): GLP Mate: GLP-1 Shot Tracker, How to calculate BMI in kg and cm or lb and inches, with the WHO category chart, a worked example and a calculator. For adults only.
- [Semaglutide, Tirzepatide and Liraglutide Half-Life Chart](https://apps.schimpf.es/glp1/semaglutide-tirzepatide-half-life-chart/index.md): GLP Mate: GLP-1 Shot Tracker, Half-life of semaglutide, tirzepatide and liraglutide, with a decay table, the formula and a worked example of how much is left days after a dose.
- [Death Anniversary Date Calculator and Leap Day Rule](https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/death-anniversary-date-calculator/index.md): Grief Letter Journal, Find the next death anniversary or birthday of someone you lost, count the days left, and see how a 29 February date is handled.
- [Unsent Letter Prompts for Grief, by Relationship](https://apps.schimpf.es/grief-letter-journal/unsent-letter-prompts-for-grief/index.md): Grief Letter Journal, Gentle prompts for an unsent letter to a parent, partner, child, sibling, friend or pet you lost, plus simple steps to start writing.
- [Average Blood Pressure Calculator for Home Readings](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/average-blood-pressure-calculator/index.md): Health Reports: BP & Sleep PDF, Average your home blood pressure readings, see the lowest, highest and AHA category, and learn the formula with a worked example.
- [Blood Pressure Categories Chart (AHA, mmHg)](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/blood-pressure-categories-chart/index.md): Health Reports: BP & Sleep PDF, AHA blood pressure chart with the five categories, the exact mmHg limits, how "or" rules work, and worked examples for home readings.
- [How to Make a Blood Pressure PDF from Health Connect](https://apps.schimpf.es/health-connect-pdf-reports/health-connect-blood-pressure-pdf/index.md): Health Reports: BP & Sleep PDF, Step-by-step: turn blood pressure, heart rate and sleep stored in Android Health Connect into a PDF report you can share or print for your doctor.
- [Mortgage Monthly Payment Formula With Example](https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/mortgage-monthly-payment-formula/index.md): Hipoteca: Mortgage Calculator, How a fixed-rate mortgage payment is calculated, with a worked example for 200,000 euros at 2.60 % over 30 years, and a calculator you can try.
- [Spain Mortgage Early Repayment Fee: Legal Caps](https://apps.schimpf.es/morgage-calc/spain-mortgage-early-repayment-fee/index.md): Hipoteca: Mortgage Calculator, Maximum early repayment fee on a Spanish mortgage under Ley 5/2019, by rate type and year, with a worked example and how to compare your options.
- [Bee Syrup Ratio 1:1 and 2:1 Chart and Converter](https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/bee-syrup-ratio-1-1-and-2-1/index.md): Hive Log: Beekeeping Journal, Sugar and water amounts for 1:1 and 2:1 bee syrup, with a chart, worked examples and metric to imperial conversions.
- [Bee Treatment Withdrawal Period Calculator](https://apps.schimpf.es/beekeeping-hive-log/bee-treatment-withdrawal-period-calculator/index.md): Hive Log: Beekeeping Journal, Work out when a hive treatment withdrawal period ends. Formula, three worked examples, a quick table and a calculator.
- [Horse Farrier Schedule Calculator: Next Due Date](https://apps.schimpf.es/horse-care-log/horse-farrier-schedule-calculator/index.md): Horse Care Log: Farrier & Vet, Work out when your horse's next farrier, worming or vaccine date falls from the last visit and the interval, with a worked example and a table.
- [Horse Vaccination Record: What to Write Down](https://apps.schimpf.es/horse-care-log/horse-vaccination-record-template/index.md): Horse Care Log: Farrier & Vet, What a horse vaccination record needs: product, batch number, vet, date and next due date. Includes a template table and a worked example.
- [COBRA Election Deadline: How the 60 Days Work](https://apps.schimpf.es/job-loss-12-week-plan/cobra-election-deadline-60-days/index.md): Job Loss Plan: 12-Week Guide, How long you have to elect COBRA after a layoff, when the 60 days start, how to count them and which other health coverage dates to check.

Formula, worked example and a small calculator.

- [BPM to Milliseconds Calculator and Formula](https://apps.schimpf.es/metronome-and-practice-log/bpm-to-milliseconds-calculator/index.md): Metronome & Practice Log, Convert BPM to milliseconds per beat with one formula, worked examples, and a table of note lengths from whole notes to sixteenths.
- [Tempo Markings BPM Chart: Largo to Prestissimo](https://apps.schimpf.es/metronome-and-practice-log/tempo-markings-bpm-chart/index.md): Metronome & Practice Log, A chart of Italian tempo markings with BPM ranges, what each one feels like, and how to find the right marking for your piece.

Rates table and worked examples for commercial and household.

Formula, worked example and a table for 2026 and 2027.

Formula and Example](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/how-much-paint-do-i-need-for-a-room/index.md): Paint Calc: Room Paint Amount, Work out the paint for any room: wall area, doors and windows, coats, waste and texture, with a worked example in gallons and a small calculator.

Gallons by Room Size](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-paint-coverage-calc/how-much-paint-for-a-12x12-room/index.md): Paint Calc: Room Paint Amount, A 12x12 room with 8 ft walls needs about 2 gallons and 1 quart for two coats. Table of paint by room size, with the numbers behind it.

Includes a short note on when a drawn signature is accepted.

Formula, worked example and table.
- [Plumbing Quote: Sales Tax and Deposit Math](https://apps.schimpf.es/offline-plumber-invoice-app/plumbing-quote-sales-tax-and-deposit/index.md): Plumber Invoice & Quote Maker, How to add sales tax to taxable lines only, set a deposit % on the total and find the balance due on a plumbing quote. Worked example and calculator.
- [How to Find Duplicate Files on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/find-duplicate-files-on-android/index.md): Storage Analyzer: Big Files, How to find exact duplicate files on an Android phone, how checksums prove two files are the same, and which copy to keep when you delete.
- [How to Find Old Unused Files on Android](https://apps.schimpf.es/ad-free-storage-analyzer/find-old-files-on-android/index.md): Storage Analyzer: Big Files, Find files you have not changed for more than 90 days: old downloads, screenshots, WhatsApp media and APK installers. See the rules and a worked example.

- [DAF Delay Settings in ms: What to Set and Why](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/daf-delay-settings-ms/index.md): Stutter Practice: DAF, How much delay to set for delayed auditory feedback, why your phone adds its own delay, and a worked example with a calculator.
- [Easy Onset Exercises for Stuttering, Step by Step](https://apps.schimpf.es/android-stutter-practice-offline/easy-onset-exercises-stuttering/index.md): Stutter Practice: DAF, How to practice easy onset (gentle voice start) for stuttering, with a six-step exercise ladder and the 120 ms rise-time rule.

- [TDS Due Dates and Late Interest Calculation](https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/tds-due-dates-and-late-interest/index.md): TDS Section Calc India, Monthly TDS deposit dates, 26Q return dates, and how to work out interest for late deduction or deposit and the late filing fee.
- [TDS on Contractor Payment 194C: Calculator and Example](https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/tds-on-contractor-payment-194c-calculator/index.md): TDS Section Calc India, Work out TDS under section 194C: rate for individuals and companies, the Rs 30,000 and Rs 1,00,000 limits, and a worked example.
- [TDS Rate Chart FY 2025-26 with New Section Numbers](https://apps.schimpf.es/india-offline-tds-section-calc/tds-rate-chart-fy-2025-26/index.md): TDS Section Calc India, Non-salary TDS rates, thresholds and no-PAN rates for FY 2025-26, with each section's matching number in the Income-tax Act 2025.
